title: Jankurai repair-queue record
description: Attestation schema for one line of the JSONL repair queue emitted by `jankurai audit` and uploaded by the hub tool-adoption lane as target/jankurai/repair-queue.jsonl. Each line routes one finding to the next agent with a typed repair hint so the rerun is local.

rule_id.description: The finding rule this repair task closes.

path.description: The narrowest path the repair applies to.

purpose.description: What the repair is meant to achieve.

common_fixes.description: The common fixes an agent should try, in order.

repair_hint.description: A typed, one-line hint for the next agent.

docs_url.description: Local docs URL with the full convention.

rerun_command.description: The lane to rerun to confirm the repair.
